Component atlas

What a cid is. A component's identity, not its character. ucs:53E3 is the Unicode scalar U+53E3 in hexadecimal — 53E3 is 21475, the code point of 口. chise:GT-K00059 is a part CHISE names that no code point covers; it carries a private-use scalar internally. An old description could name one part bsp:22 (BabelStone's numbered component) and another chise:GT-K00125; both are aliases of one cid.

Used in counts descriptions naming this component, not characters: a character described two ways counts twice. Appears in lists the characters those descriptions describe, capped at 120. Unencoded marks a part with no code point, so no font draws it.

Built 2026-11-04 from data/ids-corpus.json.gz (211,319 descriptions, GPL-2.0-or-later because the CHISE rows are, the BabelStone ones public domain, see data/COPYING-chise-ids.txt). Every component a description uses, most used first. A count covers only what the corpus describes: a part named through a CHISE entity that is still unresolved is not yet counted, so treat these as a floor.
